name: Android
description: Semi-organic beings crafted by advanced technology. They possess fully realized artificial intelligence, giving them unique personalities and quirks, though they are often treated as property under the law.

name: Aquarian
description: Sturdy humanoids adapted to the crushing pressures and darkness of the ocean floor. While resilient beneath the waves, they dehydrate rapidly on dry land.

name: Avion
description: Slight, winged humanoids with hollow bones. Their physiology grants them the gift of flight and sharp eyesight, but makes them fragile and a liability in deep water.

name: Dwarf
description: Stout, robust mountain-dwellers known for their longevity and martial pride. Generations of underground living have adapted their eyes to the dark, though their short legs make them slower than other races.

name: Elf
description: Graceful, long-lived denizens of ancient forests and hidden valleys. They are naturally agile and possess keen sight in dim light, but often have a cultural or inherent disdain for mechanical devices.

name: Half-Elf
description: Caught between two worlds, these individuals inherit the longevity and physical traits of elves combined with human versatility. They often struggle to find true acceptance in either society.

name: Half-Folk
description: Diminutive, optimistic people who prefer quiet, close-knit communities. Despite their small stature and slower pace, their inherent luck and high spirits often see them through deadly situations.

name: Human
description: The most versatile and widespread of the sentient races. What they lack in inherent biological advantages, they make up for with extreme adaptability and determination.

name: Rakashan
description: Feline humanoids boasting sharp claws, fangs, and a predatory grace. They are beautiful but dangerous, known for a bloodthirsty streak that makes other races wary of them.

name: Saurian
description: Reptilian humanoids hailing from steaming jungles and harsh deserts. They boast natural armor and acute senses, but their cold-blooded ancestry makes them highly vulnerable to freezing temperatures.
